# Solven

> Solven is a car marketplace for South Korea, built for the Uzbek, Russian and
> Korean-speaking community: browse new and used cars from verified dealers and
> private sellers, reserve a car with a small deposit, message sellers, read
> purchase-verified reviews, and find trusted mechanics for repairs and inspections.

Site: https://solven.uz
Languages: English, Korean, Russian, Uzbek
Built and maintained by: Murod Mirzaliev (https://github.com/imurodl)

## What Solven is

Solven is a full-stack marketplace. Buyers filter listings by brand, model,
body type, fuel, gearbox, price, mileage and year; compare prices with the
built-in fair-price estimate; reserve a car online (5% deposit, seller accepts,
handover, buyer confirms); chat with the seller; and leave a review after the
deal. Dealers manage listings, hot deals with countdowns and incoming
reservations from their dashboard. Mechanics showcase completed repair work and
receive service requests.

## Pages

- [Home](https://solven.uz): trending cars, hot deals, top dealers, community
- [Listings](https://solven.uz/car): full catalogue with filters and sorting
- [AI Finder](https://solven.uz/ai-finder): upload a photo of a car, get matching listings
- [Service](https://solven.uz/service): mechanics and completed repair showcases
- [Dealers](https://solven.uz/agent): dealer profiles, ratings and their listings
- [Community](https://solven.uz/community): articles and discussion
- [Help](https://solven.uz/help): FAQ, notices, terms
- [About](https://solven.uz/about)

## Technology

Next.js 14 (TypeScript, Pages Router), NestJS 10, MongoDB, GraphQL (Apollo)
with WebSocket notifications, JWT authentication with Google and Telegram
login, Docker and Nginx on Oracle Cloud (ARM).
